<parameter=code>
# Check current positions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['c', 'Y']:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"{n['color']}: pixels={n['pixels']} rows={min(rows)}-{max(rows)} cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Try DOWN to move dark gray down
print("\nTrying DOWN:")
for i in range(15):
    result = action(['DOWN'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    c_objects = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c']
    y_objects = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 72]
    if c_objects:
        c = c_objects[0]
        b = c['boundary']
        c_rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        c_cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"DOWN {i+1}: dark_gray rows={min(c_rows)}-{max(c_rows)} cols={min(c_cols)}-{max(c_cols)}")
    else:
        print(f"DOWN {i+1}: dark_gray GONE")
        break
    if result.get('level_completed'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
